title: Cosmo: when the agent model stalls, offer the other tested model in the chat
description: A Cosmo turn that times out or gets a 429/5xx from the host shows a card in the chat: the model is not answering, likely the host's side, with a button that switches Cosmo to the best other agent-tested model on the same connection and sends Continue. Found 2026-10-24: MiMo-V2.6-Flash on DeepInfra stalled 45-60 s per step then timed out at 180 s while Gemma on DeepInfra answered in 6 s; switching to DeepSeek-V4-Flash-0731 finished at once.
